SELECT c.id, c.cart_code, c.model_id, m.model_code, m.model_name, COALESCE(c.actual_capacity, m.max_capacity) AS max_capacity, c.current_quantity, -- status：维修状态保持数据库值，其他状态基于 current_quantity 计算 CASE WHEN c.status = 4 THEN 4 WHEN c.current_quantity = 0 THEN 1 WHEN c.current_quantity >= COALESCE(c.actual_capacity, m.max_capacity) THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS status, c.area, c.bind_worker, c.actual_capacity, su1.nickname AS created_by_name, c.created_time, su2.nickname AS updated_by_name, c.updated_time FROM wms_cart c LEFT JOIN wms_cart_model m ON c.model_id = m.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su1 ON c.created_by = su1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su2 ON c.updated_by = su2.id
AND (c.cart_code LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%' OR c.bind_worker LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%')
-- 维修状态直接匹配数据库值
AND c.status = 4
-- 其他状态基于 current_quantity 计算 AND ( CASE WHEN c.status = 4 THEN 4 WHEN c.current_quantity = 0 THEN 1 WHEN c.current_quantity >= COALESCE(c.actual_capacity, m.max_capacity) THEN 3 ELSE 2 END ) = #{query.status}
AND c.model_id = #{query.modelId}
AND c.area LIKE '%' || #{query.area} || '%'
ORDER BY c.cart_code ASC
SELECT DISTINCT c.area FROM wms_cart c WHERE c.area IS NOT NULL AND c.area != '' ORDER BY c.area ASC
